recommendation: Keep the audit commit. Reopen source work only if a current package publication again exposes a DSTU2 StructureDefinition.fhirVersion of 1.9.0 or another unsupported FHIRVersion code.
issue_request: FHIR-20783 was a Published/Persuasive technical correction asking to fix an IG Publisher failure when an empty package cache caused hl7.fhir.core#1.0.2 to load a StructureDefinition with unknown FHIRVersion code '1.9.0'.
initial_application: No source commit in this checkout explicitly mentions FHIR-20783. The fix appears to have been applied to the affected package payload rather than as a durable current-source change.
additional_context: FHIR-I minutes changed the issue to technical correction/will-fix, and the linked Zulip report frames it as a wrong version declaration in package resources. Later FHIRVersion terminology and definition work such as FHIR-26067 and FHIR-35168 is separate and already represented independently.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Current source has no fhirVersion 1.9.0 value, the FHIRVersion code system includes DSTU2 1.0.2, and current hl7.fhir.core#1.0.2/R2 package checks found fhirVersions set to 1.0.2 with no fhirVersion 1.9.0 occurrences.

related_jiras.note: Later published FHIRVersion CodeSystem work that explains the current major/minor and patch-code model but does not decide this DSTU2 package-cache bug.
Later published fhirVersion definition cleanup already represented on the combined branch, separate from this package fix.
